name: Pressure Hull Section Mk1
description: First-stage pressure hull section, 4 m long and 4 m across: thin ribs, end flanges, an orange band and a hatch pad. Axis along the sub (Y in glTF is up, the long axis is Z).

name: Pressure Hull Section Mk2
description: Second-stage pressure hull section: thicker ribs plus eight outer armour plates on a 4.2 m diameter shell.

name: Pressure Hull Section Mk3
description: Third-stage pressure hull section: heavy ribs, twelve armour plates, brass bolt blocks and a glowing seam on a 4.5 m diameter shell.

name: Shell Reinforcement Plating
description: Hull section wrapped in ten purple shell plates with gold edging and a gold-and-purple spiral shell on top: a look for the shell the hermit crab donates to the sub.

name: Small Thruster
description: Ducted four-blade thruster on a bracket with a rear motor. Thrust axis along the sub; mount point at the origin.

name: Main Engine
description: Large engine pod: a ducted five-blade propeller, a thick motor body with a glowing exhaust ring, and a mounting plate with two struts. About 4 m long.

name: Ballast Tank
description: Twin horizontal tanks with domed ends, orange bands and a brass valve wheel on a base plate.

name: Battery Pack
description: Four battery cells in a frame with glowing charge strips, brass terminals and a cable.

name: Sonar Dish
description: Parabolic sonar dish with a glowing face, a feed horn and three struts on a rotating mast.

name: Hydrophone Array
description: Flat 3 by 5 array of rubber-ringed transducers with glowing and orange dots on a 3 m plate.

name: Headlamp
description: Round headlamp with a reflector cone, glowing bulb, glass lens and a protective grille, on a short bracket.

name: Floodlight Bar
description: Work-light bar 3 m wide with six warm lamps and orange end caps.

name: Manipulator Arm
description: Three-segment work arm with a swivel base, orange joints and a two-finger brass claw. Rest pose reaches about 4 m forward.

name: Tether Winch
description: Winch with a flanged drum wound in brass cable, a guide arm, a hook and an orange motor housing.

name: Cargo Pod
description: Capsule cargo pod 3.2 m long with a top hatch, three orange bands, a side door and mounting rails.

name: Sample Rack
description: Rack of six glass sample tubes with glowing contents (cyan, amber, purple) and rubber caps.

name: Hatch Tower
description: Round hatch tower 2 m tall with a wheel-handled lid, handrails, a ladder and a warm lamp.

name: Dome Viewport
description: Glass dome window 2.6 m across with a framing ring, twelve bolts, a cross frame and a soft interior lamp.

name: Antenna Mast
description: 4 m communications mast with three glowing rings, small panel antennas, a dish and an orange tip light.

name: Repair Kit
description: Orange toolbox with a handle, open side tray and loose tools: a wrench, a purple patch plate and bolts. Fits a post-battle repair scene.
